objective: Implement a bounded TED Search API connector and source-quality probe without enabling production ingestion or canonical procurement claims.
outcome: A fixed-profile connector performs one allowlisted, non-personal Search API POST, validates the response envelope, preserves optional fields, records hashes and fails closed on redirects, endpoint drift, duplicates, malformed publication numbers, oversized responses or empty results.

skills.activation_reason: Implement the official TED Search API transport contract.
Validate response shape, duplicates, optionality and quality evidence.
Enforce host/path allowlists, HTTPS, response budgets and no redirects.
Prove that the fixed projection requests no personal contact fields.
Provide fixture, mock-transport and live technical-probe evidence.

external: Official TED Search API endpoint availability

prohibited_scope: Silent fallback to scraping or another source

acceptance_evidence.description: Fixture and mock tests prove exact request, optional-field preservation and fail-closed URL and response handling.
Live endpoint returns a bounded page and produces a non-sensitive content hash and request hash.
Connector refuses redirects, credentials in URLs, non-standard ports, unexpected hosts, paths, queries and fragments.
Source runbook separates JSON projection, XML notice and SDK JSON metadata.

rollback.strategy: Remove the connector from execution paths, set the source state to RESTRICTED and preserve only frozen non-personal fixtures and audit evidence.
rollback.kill_switch: The connector is not wired into the runtime and live_enabled must be explicitly true.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The connector retrieves official procurement discovery evidence.
Content and request hashes support later provenance; no claim is admitted.
The probe fields are precursors to geography, buyer and lifecycle views.
The connector has no user-interest input and cannot rank truth by attention.
Multilingual titles and buyers are preserved as source values without lossy flattening.
Official source retrieval and persistent lineage are prerequisites for differentiated research state.
The connector performs read-only observation and no bid or investment action.
Only approved non-personal fields are requested under a documented source record.
Live retrieval is off by default and no runtime wiring exists.
The connector advances the authorised first-source technical probe.
